instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the website strictly uses the deep navy (#0B132B / #1C2541) and rich gold (#D4AF37) visual palette.
Ensure Cormorant Garamond is imported and used for headlines with Outfit for crisp UI body text.
Implement the full dual-mode architecture: Top navigation bar lets users switch between 'Website Mode' and 'AI Advisory Mode' smoothly.

In AI Advisory Mode, render a split view: Left side displays dynamic canvas cards (auto-filling intake form, service insights, tax calculators, team profiles) and Right side displays the AI chat interface.
Include real-time voice chat features: OpenAI Whisper speech-to-text trigger + Speech Synthesis audio response playback with an audio visualizer.
Implement the emergent Google login widget and persist user session in frontend local storage / context.
Ensure all forms and buttons have proper data-testid attributes.
